# Renshin Karate School International

> Renshin Karate School International is a premier martial arts academy in Peelamedu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Founded and led by International Karate Medalist Master Arunmadhavan E.V.R., the school provides World Karate Federation (WKF) accredited training in Kumite, Kata, Kids Discipline, Women's Self-Defense, and 1-on-1 VIP Mentorship.

## Core Facts & Directory Data
- **Official Name**: Renshin Karate School International (also known as Ren Shin Karate School)
- **Founder & Chief Instructor**: Arunmadhavan E.V.R. (International Karate Medalist, Certified WKF Coach)
- **Lineage & Standards**: World Karate Federation (WKF) Standards • Renshin Karate School International (Founded independently by Sensei Arunmadhavan E.V.R.)
- **Google Maps Rating**: 5.0 / 5.0 stars based on 76 verified Google reviews

## Programs & Training Tracks
1. **Kids Karate & Character Architecture (Ages 4–14)**:
   - Focuses on screen-free physical agility, attention stamina, anti-bullying reflexes, respect, and traditional dojo etiquette (Rei).
   - Class ratios capped at 15 students for individualized posture correction.
2. **WKF World Championship Kumite & Kata Squad**:
   - High-velocity competitive Olympic/WKF rule sparring, electronic point scoring simulation, rapid counter-striking, and blitz Kizami-Zuki combinations.
   - Proven track record with student podium finishes at district, state, national, and international competitions.
3. **Women & Executive Tactical Self-Defense**:
   - Practical, leverage-based martial defense requiring zero prior martial arts experience.
   - Escape mechanics against chokes, wrist grabs, ground attacks, and situational awareness training.
4. **1-on-1 VIP Personal Mentorship**:
   - Private training with Sensei Arunmadhavan E.V.R., customized video biomechanical review, and flexible executive scheduling.

## Belt Progression Syllabus (Kyu to Dan)
- **10th Kyu (White Belt)**: Foundation stances (Zenkutsu-Dachi, Kiba-Dachi), linear strikes (Oi-Zuki), and Taikyoku Shodan.
- **8th Kyu (Yellow Belt)**: Heian Shodan, front snap kick (Mae-Geri), and Gohon Kumite.
- **7th Kyu (Orange Belt)**: Heian Nidan, knife-hand blocks (Shuto-Uke), and Sanbon Kumite.
- **6th Kyu (Green Belt)**: Heian Sandan, roundhouse kicks (Mawashi-Geri), and Ippon Kumite.
- **4th Kyu (Blue Belt)**: Heian Yondan & Godan, spinning kicks (Ushiro-Geri), and Jiyu Kumite.
- **1st–3rd Kyu (Brown Belt)**: Master katas (Bassai Dai, Kanku Dai) and advanced tournament tactics.
- **Shodan (1st Dan Black Belt)**: Master of fundamentals, accredited by International Karate Federation.
